description: Write a pandas ETL script for saas_metrics that deduplicates customer records by normalized email and phone. The script should: (1) normalize email (trim, lower case) and phone (digits only; a 10-digit number gets country code 1; output as +<digits>), (2) link records that share a normalized email or a normalized phone, transitively, (3) for each linked cluster keep one survivor: the record with the earliest created_at, enriched with the first non-null normalized email and phone found in the cluster ordered by created_at, (4) output the survivor row plus merged_ids listing all source ids in the cluster, (5) never link records through null or empty values.
edge_cases: c2 and c3 share nothing directly; they are linked transitively through c1 (email with c2, phone with c3)
c4 and c5 have null/empty identifiers and must stay separate; grouping on null keys would merge all anonymous customers
Empty string email is treated as null
The survivor c3 has no email of its own and inherits the cluster's normalized email
drop_duplicates on a single column cannot express transitive matching; a union-find or connected-components approach is needed
common_failure_modes: FM1: Self-join on nullable keys links every record with a null email or phone
FM7: Normalization skipped, so case and formatting variants are not detected as duplicates
FM3: Deduplicating on email and phone in two separate passes loses transitive links and survivor enrichment
